description: Shell script for testing cloning repositories and handling files with Mock LFS, including functions for verifying file states and test sequences for different configurations.

methods.name: test_file_is_not_in_mock_lfs
methods.description: Verifies that a file is not stored in Mock LFS by comparing content.

methods.name: test_file_is_in_mock_lfs
methods.description: Verifies that a file is stored in Mock LFS by checking pointers and content in local and remote storage.

methods.name: test_file_is_deleted_in_mock_lfs
methods.description: Verifies that a file has been deleted from the repository but remains in local and remote storage.

methods.name: test_file_count_in_dir
methods.description: Counts files in a directory and compares with expected count.
